I recently received treatment at Doctor Lamai Clinic, and the service was excellent. I went in because of food poisoning, and I received an injection, lab tests, take-home medication, IV fluids, and observation. All of this cost only less than £160. Everything was quick and efficient.

They even contacted my UK insurance on my behalf. In the end, I didn’t have to pay anything because the clinic handled the insurance claim for me. Their assistance was truly outstanding.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone visiting Koh Samui. Their prices are much more affordable compared to 2–3 other clinics I checked. The staff were compassionate, talked to me so I wouldn’t feel lonely, and made me feel comfortable. I didn’t feel scared to speak with strangers at all — everyone was incredibly friendly.

If I could give them 100 stars, I absolutely would.🥹❤️🙏
